title: ETL and SQL Aggregation
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of database loading, group/sum/mean, and query scripts, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in retail-sales-forecasting.
learning_objectives: Explain database loading, group/sum/mean, and query scripts in plain language and connect it to sql/retail_analysis.sql; run_all_queries.py; app.py.
Trace one input through the etl and sql aggregation stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: database loading, group/sum/mean, and query scripts
practical_outcomes: Trace the etl and sql aggregation stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for database loading, group/sum/mean, and query scripts.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
